item.title: Seven Seas Licenses SLEEPING IDIOT / NEMURUBAKA Manga By HEAVENLY DELUSION Creator Masakazu Ishiguro
item.description: Seven Seas Entertainment has acquired the English rights to Sleeping Idiot, a heartfelt slice-of-life manga from Masakazu Ishiguro, set for release in November 2026 under the Seven Seas GL label.

item.title: TERMINATOR ZERO Creator Confirms Netflix Has Canceled The Anime Series
item.description: Netflix has canceled Terminator Zero despite critical acclaim, ending its standalone anime story after one season while leaving hints of a larger saga.

item.title: Science Saru's THE GHOST IN THE SHELL Anime To Stream On Prime Video
item.description: Prime Video will serve as the global streaming home for Science Saru's highly anticipated The Ghost in the Shell anime, which is scheduled to release this July.

item.title: ONE PIECE Actor Taz Skylar Shares Extreme Fasting Routine Behind Sanji Transformation For Season 2
item.description: One Piece actor Taz Skylar stunned fans by revealing the extreme fasting and grueling workouts he did to physically become Sanji for Season 2.

item.title: ONE PIECE Anime Confirms "Elbaph Arc" Premiere Date
item.description: The One Piece anime will return with the premiere of the Elbaph arc on April 6th. New episodes will stream on Crunchyroll. Additionally, the final English dub episodes of Egghead Island arrive next month.

item.title: DEMON SLAYER: INFINITY CASTLE Returning To Theaters In North America, Likely Delaying Streaming Release
item.description: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle returns to North American theaters next month in immersive SCREENX, a 270-degree format, which could delay its streaming debut.

item.title: JUJUTSU KAISEN Complete Box Set Announced; All 30 Volumes And Volume 0 Arrive Fall 2026
item.description: Releasing later this year, the Jujutsu Kaisen Complete Box Set from VIZ Media features all 30 volumes, including Volume 0 and a double-sided poster of Gege Akutami's acclaimed supernatural fantasy manga.

item.title: DEMON SLAYER: INFINITY CASTLE PART 2 And GENSHIN IMPACT Teased In Ufotable Highlight Reel
item.description: Ufotable has released a highlight reel of future projects, giving us our first look at the Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Part 2 logo and teasing the long-awaited Genshin Impact anime.

item.title: Ufotable Confirms WITCH ON THE HOLY NIGHT Release Window With New Footage
item.description: Ufotable has shared some new footage from the studio's long-awaited Witch on the Holy Night anime feature, confirming the film will release in theaters sometime this year.

item.title: Netflix Drops STEEL BALL RUN JOJO'S BIZARRE ADVENTURE English Dub Trailer Ahead Of Premiere
item.description: The first stage of Steel Ball Run: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure gallops onto Netflix in just a few weeks. Get pumped with this English dub trailer of the highly-anticipated anime.
